description: This header file defines functions and macros for quoting and dequoting strings, especially in the context of shell commands, paths, and language literals. It provides utilities to produce shell-safe quoted strings, dequote strings, and quote strings for various languages. It also includes function declarations for quoting paths relative to a prefix and writing quoted names to files.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, escaping necessary characters and enclosing in single quotes.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-style arguments and quotes it as a single shell-safe argument.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Pretty version of sq_quote_buf for human-readable output without quoting when unnecessary.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Pretty version of sq_quote_argv, human-readable output.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends a prettily quoted argument vector to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string produced by sq_quote, returning the unquoted version.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single quoted item and advances the pointer.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes arguments in a string into an argument array.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes arguments into a strvec, duplicating the strings.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Dequotes a string in C style, updating the end pointer.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string for C code, escaping special characters as needed.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings for C code.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a FILE stream.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative quoted name to a FILE stream, with a prefix.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path as relative to a prefix, producing a shell-safe string.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl, escaping special characters.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl with explicit length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Python.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Tcl.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in regex patterns.
